source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: Selected chest-lead checks are R > 2.5 mV in V5/V6 and RV5 + SV1 > 4.0 mV; the selected limb-lead check is R > 1.5 mV in I. Not all criteria must be positive simultaneously.

R-dominant left-sided leads have downsloping ST depression exceeding 0.05 mV and inverted T waves; S-dominant V1 has upright T. Left-axis deviation is a possible feature, but this example does not additionally alter the axis.
scope: A single teaching example of LVH with secondary ST-T changes, not a diagnosis or anatomical calibration.

authored_choices.construction: Limb QRS is multiplied by 3. Chest electrode QRS equals twice the original chest electrode plus the original Wilson mean, approximately doubling projected chest leads. The mean uses Int128/ties-to-even arithmetic with at most Q32 rounding residue.
authored_choices.basis: Reuses the original QRS/T and smooth ST kernels. Parameters are authored choices, not exact textbook case data.

compatibility: P/u are allowed; PR/QT and atrial events are preserved. Simultaneous manual T/ST, fusion, infarction and three-zone modes are rejected. Atrial/ventricular activity gating still applies.
verification: Checks projected voltages at 250 Hz, ST slope/T polarity, Einthoven identities, unchanged P/u, source recovery, native pixels and atomic rejection. Increased row spacing retains 40 logical pixels/mV and prevents high-amplitude waveforms from entering adjacent rows.
limitations: Does not represent actual myocardial mass or hemodynamic changes.
Not all LVH voltage/morphology variants or continuous electrical-axis changes are implemented.
Right ventricular and biventricular hypertrophy remain unimplemented.
Manual verification on Windows hardware is deferred to a combined session.
